title: Inspect one merge-base comparison through Changed, Affected, and Code
preconditions: A branch diverges from main with documentation and source changes plus at least one unexplained source file.

steps.action: Open the branch against main and resolve the comparison range.
steps.expected_result: The comparison begins at the actual merge base and reports compare mode.

steps.action: Inspect a revised story in the Changed layer.
steps.expected_result: The story appears once with before and after snapshots.

steps.action: Inspect code-linked design, story, and persona records after a code-only edit.
steps.expected_result: Each unchanged record appears in Affected with its explicit propagation cause.

steps.action: Inspect the Code layer for owned and unowned changed atoms.
steps.expected_result: Owned atoms group under their explanations and unowned atoms remain in the unexplained list.

steps.action: Open the same Saga without an against revision.
steps.expected_result: Observe mode reports no comparison layers or changed-line accounting.

expected_result: One merge-base range produces distinct complete Changed, Affected, and Code views without inventing a comparison in observe mode.
